title: Strata Inference
description: Strata only (namespace strata): engine state, live vs finished-request decode and prefill speed, latency, prompt/expert/context caches, MTP acceptance, GPUs, node CPU and RAM.

options.content: **Strata only.** Every query is pinned to `namespace="strata"`. Strata exports vLLM's metric names plus its own `strata:` facts (upstream `docs/DETAILS.md`). It updates token counters, cache counters and latency histograms **when a request finishes**, so rates step at completions, and its TTFT clock starts after the request leaves the queue. It exports no queue-time histogram. Settings: `my-apps/ai/strata/README.md`. Engines side by side: **Local LLM Engines**.

panels.title: Strata engine

targets.expr:
max(absent(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="strata", deployment="strata-server"})) * 4
  or (max(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="strata", deployment="strata-server"}) == 0) * 0 + 0
  or (max(up{namespace="strata", job="strata-service"}) == 0) * 0 + 1
  or (max(strata:live_state{namespace="strata", state="unloaded"}) == 1) * 0 + 3
  or (max(up{namespace="strata", job="strata-service"}) == 1) * 0 + 2
  or vector(1)

panels.description: From Git replicas, the Strata scrape target and its own state. Parked means 0 replicas on purpose (the other engine has the cards), not an outage.

panels.title: Activity

targets.expr: max(strata:live_state{namespace="strata", state="idle"} * 1 or strata:live_state{namespace="strata", state="reading"} * 2 or strata:live_state{namespace="strata", state="generating"} * 3 or strata:live_state{namespace="strata", state="unloaded"} * 4)

panels.description: strata:live_state for the newest request: idle, reading the prompt, or generating.

panels.title: Requests waiting
panels.description: Queued for the engine or a batch slot. LiteLLM caps the gateway at the slot count.

panels.title: Live decode speed

targets.expr: max by (model_name) (strata:live_tok_s{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}) and on (model_name) (max by (model_name) (strata:live_state{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model", state="generating"}) == 1)

panels.description: strata:live_tok_s over the last seconds; shown only while a request is generating.

panels.title: Live prefill speed

targets.expr: max by (model_name) (strata:live_prefill_tok_s_mean{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}) and on (model_name) (max by (model_name) (strata:live_state{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model", state="reading"}) == 1)

panels.description: Mean prompt-reading rate of the running request, excluding its cached prefix.

panels.title: Context window
panels.description: strata:engine_max_context, tokens.

panels.title: Active decode speed (range)

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:generation_tokens_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range])) / sum by (model_name) (increase(strata:totals_decode_seconds_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Generated tokens ÷ Strata's decode time: speed while generating, idle time excluded.

panels.title: Last request decode speed
panels.description: strata:last_decode_tok_s: the most recent finished request only. It keeps its value while idle, so it is not a live reading.

panels.title: Active prefill speed (range)

targets.expr: (sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range])) - sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range]))) / sum by (model_name) (increase(strata:totals_prompt_seconds_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Newly read prompt tokens (prompt − reused) ÷ Strata's prompt-reading time.

panels.title: Wall-clock generation throughput (range)
panels.description: All generated tokens ÷ the whole range, idle time included: a busy-ness number, not speed.

panels.title: Decode speed while generating

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(strata:totals_decode_seconds_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

max by (model_name) (strata:live_tok_s{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}) and on (model_name) (max by (model_name) (strata:live_state{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model", state="generating"}) == 1)

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range

panels.description: Window line = finished requests' tokens ÷ their decode time. Live = the running request. Last request holds its value while idle.

panels.title: Tokens per second (wall clock)

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range

panels.description: Idle time counts as 0, and counters move only when a request finishes.

targets.expr: (sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (model_name) (rate(strata:totals_prompt_seconds_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

max by (model_name) (strata:live_prefill_tok_s_mean{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}) and on (model_name) (max by (model_name) (strata:live_state{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model", state="reading"}) == 1)

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range

panels.title: What the engine is doing

targets.expr: max(strata:live_state{namespace="strata", state="idle"} * 1 or strata:live_state{namespace="strata", state="reading"} * 2 or strata:live_state{namespace="strata", state="generating"} * 3 or strata:live_state{namespace="strata", state="unloaded"} * 4)

panels.description: Sampled every scrape (30 s); short reads between scrapes can be missed.

panels.title: Time to first token

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range

panels.description: Starts after the request leaves Strata's queue; prompt reading dominates.

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range

panels.title: Inter-token gap (per-request means)

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range

panels.description: Strata records each request's mean gap once per token, so these are percentiles of request averages, not single gaps.

defaults.noValue: Not exported: Strata lists slots only with batch slots on (PARALLEL > 1)

panels.title: Prompt cache reuse (range)

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range])) / sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Prompt tokens Strata already held from an earlier turn (vllm:prefix_cache_*).

panels.title: Expert cache hit, last request
panels.description: VRAM share of the experts the last request looked up; experts read over PCIe are not counted.

panels.title: Context used by the running request
panels.description: Strata reports the running request's tokens ÷ its context window under this vLLM name; it is not GPU KV memory and reads 0 when idle.

panels.title: MTP draft acceptance (range)

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range])) / sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Accepted ÷ offered draft tokens from Strata's MTP layer.

panels.title: Prompt cache reuse and MTP acceptance

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range

GPU power

panels.description: Near full by design: the expert cache takes the VRAM left after weights and KV.

panels.title: Node CPU and RAM (whole host)

targets.expr: max by (model_name) (strata:ram_used_bytes{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"}) / max by (model_name) (strata:ram_total_bytes{namespace="strata", model_name=~"$model"})
